title: A north-facing mounted rider is not hit by a Throw crossing the mount anchor

verification.actor: Current mounted Cyndaquil (155), Wild Geodude (74), and Wild Bellsprout (69) at Route 29 map 33; rider anchor (585,407) faces north.
verification.trigger: Capture Geodude’s real Player Trigger first, then create the current Bellsprout Cargo. Let its normal Throw cross the stationary player tile.
verification.observable: Bellsprout completes its airborne Hop through the mount body box without reaching the visible north-facing rider. One real mount hit uses the existing shared one-tile knockback; the rider returns to its exact seat and height. Player HP and saved HP stay100 with zero accepted hits.

setupMutations.change: Use a checked teleport, a party Cyndaquil and native mount, then two native Wild spawns. Bind all three current actors. Do not change Throw timing, player HP, or collision.

limits: Prepared placement proves the subsequent natural Throw and collision result, not population spawn selection.
A missing mount offset, stale actor, absent airborne old-box crossing, battle task, or changed post-flight HP fails.
Mount movement is permitted only by one authenticated real-party contact and its exact shared forced plan. Missing motion commit or an incorrect final seat fails.

events.value: Place the north-facing player and native mount. Bind Geodude and wait for its real Player Trigger; then spawn and bind Bellsprout.
Wait for Geodude’s normal pickup and Bellsprout’s launched Hop.
Observe the airborne old-box crossing and unchanged mounted rider HP.

stop.condition: One launched flight, 64 following completed game frames, checked HP 100 with zero hits, or first failed identity, pose, motion, field, or HP observation.

invariants: All three current actors retain their exact identities
The north-facing rider starts stationary at (585,407); after one real mount hit its shared forced knockback ends seated at (585,408) with the same height and offset
Bellsprout flies from Geodude into the old anchor box without reaching the rider box
HP and saved HP remain 100 with zero accepted hits
The shared mount knockback has one current reservation and a completed commit; normal player movement and other motion owners are not accepted
